Subject: Re: Invoice 2029-88 — payment approach

Monica,

Quick one from our AP team — the client card on file failed for the full amount and treasury is asking to split the payment across two rails so we can keep services live this week. Proposed waterfall: 60% via ACH to your main operating account, 30% into the escrow routing you provided for this quarter, and 10% on a virtual card (we will absorb the card fees if needed).

Before we can send ACH we need Redwood's AML questionnaire completed by the end of day tomorrow (their compliance flagged the account). Attaching our standard AML collection form and the invoice for reference.

Attachments: zenpay_invoice_2029-88.pdf, zenpay_aml_inquiry_template.docx

Can you confirm which routing/account to use for the ACH leg and if escrow instructions are still the same? Also confirm whether Redwood can accept the 30% into escrow (we noted an older PO for the escrow).

Thanks — Priya
Priya Shah

Hi Priya — appreciate the heads-up. We can do a waterfall split; suggested plan below and next steps.

Suggested waterfall (Redwood proposal):
- 60% ACH to Operating Account (ACH instructions in attached).
- 30% to Redwood Escrow Account (we will confirm PO release conditions).
- 10% via virtual card — we generally prefer netting card fees against the next invoice, but absorbing fee is ok for this instance.

Next steps:
1) I attached a short remit_waterfall_proposal.xlsx that maps exact amounts and cutoffs.
2) Please complete the ZenPay AML form you referenced (zenpay_aml_custform.xlsx) and return to compliance@redwood.com — we cannot release escrow until AML clears.
3) Sean — can you confirm the escrow routing and whether legal needs an updated PO for the escrow split?

We aim to have ACH initiated by Wed if docs come back today.

Regards,
Monica Patel
Sr. Revenue Operations Manager, Redwood Inference

- For the ACH leg, please use the following: Redwood Operating ACH — Routing 111000025 / Account 987654321. Memo: INV-2029-88 / ZenPay.

Once the AML form is in, compliance will confirm and Laura can push the PO amendment; then we can accept the split and process ACH on our side.
